verdict_a_behavior_evidence.finding: The bounded native run supports that a guest opened SEO and Schema for the owned title-only localhost fixture at native-default 360px width; SEO showed the title and an em dash for description with only Title & description and Performance groups, Schema JSON was valid with title metadata and no description, canonical, OG, Twitter, schema types, or JSON-LD, and full-capture export identity and SHA-256 digest were unchanged after each pane.
basis: Downloaded native test result independently matches the sanitized run receipt and records native_stage=exercise_panel, status=pass, and browser Chrome/141.0.7390.37.
Harness creates an owned HTML page with only a title and explicitly checks absence of body text, language, description, canonical/social/hreflang metadata, JSON-LD, headings, links, and images.
Pane assertions require a visible active Scrape result pane, selected pane label, title and empty-field values, and valid empty schema counts.

Capture exports are read three times through the guest For AI agent clipboard export; fingerprints require the expected URL/title/full-capture form and compare both timestamp identity and SHA-256 payload digest.
The viewport selector observed innerWidth=360 in narrow/native_default mode without CDP width emulation.

limits: One owned localhost guest fixture and only the stated T08 no-signal/empty-pane subtarget.
360px narrow native-default width only; no normal-width or alternate-width coverage.
Does not establish broader T08 coverage, other roles, Store behavior, reload behavior, current-main acceptance, or release acceptance.
